g.text: ARCHITECTURAL KV COMPRESSION: MULTI-HEAD LATENT ATTENTION (MLA) VS MHA & GQA
• Maintains full expressivity of 128 attention heads.
Status: De Facto Frontier Serving Architecture
Why Decoupled RoPE is Architecturally Required
• Rotary position embeddings rotate vectors based on position.
• If RoPE is applied directly to latent c_t^KV, the matrix
associativity trick breaks: R(Θ, m) W_UK ≠ W_UK R(Θ, m).
• By isolating RoPE onto a tiny dedicated 64-dim vector k_t^R,
the latent vector c_t^KV remains position-independent!
Enables zero HBM expansion during token decode
Standard Attention inner product against reconstructed Key:
Exploiting associative property of matrix multiplication:
Step 1: Invert Query Once in On-Chip SRAM
Executed ONCE per step on fast tensor core registers.
Step 2: Stream Only 512 Latent Dims from HBM
Memory bus streams 512 numbers instead of 8,192!
Slashes HBM Memory Bus Traffic by 4.74×
Step 3: Direct Dot-Product in Tensor Cores
High-dimensional Keys/Values are NEVER materialized in HBM!
Trades Cheap SRAM Compute for Scarce HBM Bandwidth
